remaining_risks.detail: 80 fixed updates avoid validation-driven epoch choice but do not establish nonconvex convergence or optimal training budget; optimization and overfit diagnostics remain to be observed after actual training.
Protocol cohort has65 DSS events and each inner fit uses fewer; 884808 allocated parameters in the synthetic full-input case do not imply equivalent data-active capacity or stable prognostic benefit.

External CP+RNA offset is frozen, but newly trained unimodal encoder/head contributions may drift; exact OFF fallback refers to own learned main and does not guarantee external M0 performance preservation.
All-gene original evidence remains accessible to rereading, but108 slots are still a representation bottleneck; capped region selection can omit tissue and must report coverage.

Wrong pairing preserves natural RNA finite-pattern class and may relax cancer matching for singleton strata as separately audited. It does not alone exclude all CNA-availability, sampling or platform effects.
Real coordinates, attention changes and nonzero gradients establish computational routing, not tumor-region labels, biologic causality, Hallmark validity or true cross-modal synergy.
Clinical contributes through the frozen strong offset; it does not explicitly condition local queries in this starting candidate. Do not claim demonstrated Clinical-dependent P-G attention.

Three historical inner partitions times two seeds are repeated exploratory partitions, not a unique five-fold OOF or external validation. Completion and independent replay must precede the locked single DSS evaluation; no automatic outer promotion.

Earlier synthetic CUDA performance is a resource-shape feasibility check; cold-start, H5 I/O, larger patch counts, multi-WSI patients and concurrent-worker contention prevent treating it as a formal-run time guarantee.

Qualified synthetic initial path/gene risk corrections are about 4.90e-6 and -1.73e-9; cross-direction RNA-to-path and path-to-gene gradient L2 are about 4.48e-8 and 1.76e-9. Nonzero paths can still be practically inactive; only actual locked training and diagnostics can assess usable change, and no prognostic effect is inferred.

decision_boundary: Static implementation review, current source lock and source/script-bound qualification artifact checks pass. Integrated162 synthetic tests and the three-real-fit-input probe were executed by parent and reviewed here through linked receipts only. Formal training completion, usable learned interaction, histologic truth and DSS gain are not established; this review is not a scientific GO gate.
